title: Jobs to Be Done interviews
description: Interviews about a recent switch, and jobs traced to interview evidence.

sources.title: Christensen Institute, Jobs to Be Done Theory

rules.instruction: For a Jobs to Be Done interview, ask about a recent decision, what prompted it, what else the person considered and what made change difficult.
rules.verification: Trace each proposed job to specific interview evidence. Look for a conflicting example before applying the finding to another customer segment.
